{{Lunisolar September}} 
'''September 24''' is the 24th day of month {{ill|September (Lunisolar)|ja|9月 (旧暦)|lt=September (Nagatsuki)}}  the 9th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|tomobiki|qid=Q96759840}}{{efn|ja|友引|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}}{{efn|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q9418169}} .
